# Inter Claude Code Project Communication

> When several Claude Code projects share one machine, the failures are confident wrong answers and stale state. Six laws that draw the boundary around subjects.

By Niv Dvir. Published 2026-09-08, last revised 2026-09-09. About 4,047 words.

The six laws quoted in this article are reproduced verbatim from the constitution the projects actually run on, not paraphrased.

## The article

- [Inter Claude Code Project Communication](https://nivdvir.github.io/): Six laws for running several Claude Code projects on one machine without them answering for each other.
- [Full text as plain markdown](https://nivdvir.github.io/llms-full.txt): the same article without site chrome.
